payload.task_label: case-module architecture review through candidate grilling

payload.consequence: R1 Standards could not go green; the interface was reworked to return invariant failure data, event-owned translations were added, the commit was amended, all gates were rerun, and both review axes were repeated at R2.
payload.expected: The shared publication interface would expose only invariant protocol concepts and allow a later event type to reuse it without adding event-specific parameters or switches.
payload.observed: The first reviewed interface accepted EventNoun and switched between append and early-review wording inside retry comparison and revision handling.
payload.run_condition: One new internal publication module served two later-event consumers; elapsed duration is not determinable; the deviation surfaced after the first committed implementation at R1 Standards review and that gate caught it.
payload.workaround_taken: Removed EventNoun, introduced invariant ExistingEventFailure and PublicationFailure data, and translated append and early-review wording in their separate owners.
